name: @authoflow/paperclip-video-creator
description: Paperclip adapter — automatic multi-scene video generation

configFields.label: Claude API Key
configFields.description: Anthropic API key for script and storyboard generation

configFields.label: KIE API Key
configFields.description: kie.ai API key for image generation (GPT-4o) and animation (Kling)

configFields.label: Eleven Labs API Key
configFields.description: Eleven Labs API key for voiceover generation

configFields.label: Storage Bucket
configFields.description: S3 or Cloudflare R2 bucket name for uploading the final video

configFields.label: Storage Public URL
configFields.description: Base URL for public video access, e.g. https://videos.yourdomain.com

configFields.label: Timeout (seconds)
configFields.description: Max execution time in seconds. Default: 5400 (90 minutes)
